spans.s: दह् vt. 1P (pp. दग्ध; desid. दिधक्षति) 1. To burn, to scorch, उष्णो दहति चांगारः शीतः कृष्णायते करम् Hit.i., सपदि मदनानलो दहति मम मानसम् Git.G.; 2. to torment, to pain, to distress, स्वजनाश्रु किलातिसंततं दहति प्रेतमिति प्रचक्षते R.viii.86, पुनर्दृष्टिं बाष्पप्रकरकलुषमर्पितवती मयि क्रूरे यत्तत्सविषमिव शल्यं दहति माम् Sak.vi.With निस्-, 1. to burn, to consume; 2. to torment, to distress.With परि-, to burn, to scorch, दिशि दिशि परिदग्धा भूमयः पावकेन Rt.i.24.With प्र-, 1. to burn, to burn completely; 2. to trouble, to tease, to torment.With सम्-, to burn, अभिजनः संदह्यतां वह्निना Bhartr.ii.39.
दहन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Consuming by fire, Bhartr.i.71; 2. destructive, injurious.
दहन (II) m. 1. Fire; 2. a bad man; 3. a pigeon; 4. the number ‘three.’
दहन (III) n. 1. Burning, extinguishing, R.viii.20; 2. cauterising.
दाहन n. 1. Burning, reducing to ashes; 2. cauterizing.
दहन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Consuming by fire, Bhartr.i.71; 2. destructive, injurious.
दहन-अराति m. water.
दहन-उपल m. the sun-gem.
दहन-उल्का f. a fire-brand.
दहन-केतन m. smoke.
दहन-प्रिया f. Svāhā, wife of Agni.
दहन-सारथि m. wind.
दहर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Small, fine, thin; 2. young in age.
दहर (II) m. 1. A child or any young animal; 2. a younger brother; 3. a rat; 4. the cavity of the heart.
दहर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Small, fine, thin; 2. young in age.
दह्र m. 1. Fire; 2. a forest conflagration.
दाह m. 1. Burning, conflagration, दाहशक्तिमिव कृष्णवर्त्मनि R.xi.42, त्रिपुरदाहमुमापतिसेविनः Kir.v.14; 2. glowing redness (as of the sky); 3. the sensation of burning; 4. feverish or morbid heat.
दाह-अगुरु, -काष्ठ n. a kind of agallochum.
दाह-अगुरु, -काष्ठ n. a kind of agallochum.
दाह-आत्मक a. combustible.
दाह-ज्वर m. inflammatory fever.
दाह-सर m. a place where dead bodies are burnt.
दाह-सरस् n. a place where dead bodies are burnt.
दाह-स्थल n. a place where dead bodies are burnt.
दाहक (I) a. (f. हिका) 1. Burning, kindling; 2. incendiary, inflammatory.
दाहक (II) m. Fire.
दाहक (I) a. (f. हिका) 1. Burning, kindling; 2. incendiary, inflammatory.
दाह्य a. (f. ह्या) 1. To be burnt; 2. combustible.
दाह्य a. (f. ह्या) 1. To be burnt; 2. combustible.
